@pytest.mark.parametrize('refname', ('HEAD', 'MERGE_HEAD'))
def test_get_conflicted_files_with_refname_collision(in_merge_conflict, refname):

    with open(refname, 'w') as ref_file:
        ref_file.write('not a ref\n')
    cmd_output('git', 'add', refname)

    ret = set(git.get_conflicted_files())
    assert ret == {'conflict_file', refname}
```
